correctness.rationale: The truncated tetrahedral graph is the 12 ordered distinct symbol pairs with edges for common first coordinate or reversing order, giving 18 edges and diameter three. Every integer-scale intrinsic graph Čech nerve was reconstructed from parity-dependent closed vertex/edge neighborhood generators; all face vectors and graph distances agree with RESULT.md. Independently built and fully checked acyclic discrete-Morse matchings at r0..6, with critical cells r1 (0:1,1:7), r2 (0:1,1:3), r3 (0:1,2:9), r4 (0:1,3:15,4:8), r5 (0:1,7:5), r6 (0:1). At r4 I computed the integral signed gradient-path Morse 15x8 matrix independently in trunc_integral.py: rank 4, Smith diagonal four 1s and zeros, selected (rows 0,1,2,4; columns 2,3,4,5) minor +1 and 30 nonzero entries. Integral attaching-degree classification gives wedge11 S3 ∨ wedge4 S4, not simply a rational-Betti guess. r1→r2 H1 map onto because every new distance-two edge is homologous via a Čech triangle to an old two-edge path; free abelian rank7→rank3 gives 3 long and 4 short H1 bars. Higher stages have distinct nonzero degrees, so complete integral barcode follows. Calculations finite but exhaustive for this graph.
